feature_name: Bigtable billing visibility for tagged instances
summary: Tags applied to Bigtable instances are now included in Cloud Billing data to improve usage and spend visibility.
extended_definition: Tags applied to Bigtable instances are now included in Cloud Billing data to improve usage and spend visibility.

supporting_pages.title: Create and manage instance labels \_|\_ Bigtable \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Common uses of labels Here are some common use cases for labels: Team or cost center labels : Add labels based on team or cost center to distinguish instances owned by different teams (for example, team:research and team:analytics ).
Remove a label from an instance To remove a label from a Bigtable instance using the Google Cloud console: Open the list of Bigtable instances in the Google Cloud console.
Tags provide a way to conditionally allow or deny policies based on whether a resource has a specific tag, by providing fine-grained control over policies.
